Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe

Class SevereSluggingSystemDiagnostic

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.SevereSluggingSystemDiagnostic
public final class SevereSluggingSystemDiagnostic extends Object
Stability diagnostic for a stratified flowline feeding a liquid-filled riser.

The diagnostic implements the quasi-steady stability condition derived by Taitel for severe slugging at a flowline-riser junction: 

 P_top,critical = phi rho_L g (V_G / (A_r alpha_prime) - H)

Here P_top is absolute pressure at the riser outlet, phi is average liquid holdup in the riser, rho_L is average liquid density, V_G is the compressible upstream gas volume, A_r and H are riser area and vertical height, and alpha_prime is the void fraction in the gas cap penetrating the riser. The system is stable when the effective top pressure is at least the critical pressure. A non-positive critical pressure is geometrically stable in this reduced model.

Validity is limited to a two-phase, low-rate, stratified flowline connected to a liquid-filled, constant-area rising section. The derivation assumes isothermal ideal-gas compression and neglects wall and interfacial shear during the incipient displacement. It is a stability screen, not a dynamic slug-frequency or slug-size model.

    • fromSections

      public static SevereSluggingSystemDiagnostic.Input fromSections(TwoFluidSection[] sections, int riserBaseSection, double gasCapVoidFraction, double staticChokePressureDropPa)
      Build a system descriptor from solved pipe sections.

      Sections before riserBaseSection form the level or downward-inclined feeder. Their gas-filled cell volumes are summed using each section's own area, so a flowline-to-riser diameter change is permitted. Sections from riserBaseSection onward must form a continuously rising, constant-area riser. The last section pressure is interpreted as the absolute pressure at the riser outlet.

      Parameters:
      sections - solved sections in flow direction
      riserBaseSection - index of the first continuously rising section
      gasCapVoidFraction - void fraction alpha-prime in the penetrating gas cap
      staticChokePressureDropPa - fixed pressure drop between the riser outlet and separator, in Pa
      Returns:
      immutable system input with geometry, inventory, phase, and flow-regime evidence
